title: On a grid with column headers, the header now owns the gridline below it at every scroll position, so the first body row no longer renders a pixel taller than the rest and the grid's height no longer changes when it is scrolled. `columnHeaderHeight` resolves to the same border-box height at every scroll position as a result, and because that height includes the header's 1px top and bottom borders, `columnHeaderHeight: 40` leaves a 38px content box instead of 39px on an unscrolled grid.
